title: Closed-loop evaluation of LLM agents for embedded software development
title_zh: 嵌入式软件开发中大型语言模型智能体的闭环评估

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as coding agents that edit files, run builds and tests, inspect execution results, and repair software iteratively. Embedded firmware is a demanding target because correctness depends on closed-loop behavior under sensing, timing, and safety constraints, not only on static source quality. Yet embedded-agent evaluation remains limited and often emphasizes one-shot synthesis or offline correctness.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地被部署为编码智能体，能够编辑文件、运行构建和测试、检查执行结果，并迭代修复软件。 嵌入式固件是一个极具挑战性的目标，因为其正确性不仅取决于静态源代码的质量，还依赖于在感知、时序和安全约束下的闭环行为。 然而，嵌入式智能体的评估仍然有限，且通常侧重于单次生成或离线正确性。

paragraphs.en: We present a benchmark for closed-loop evaluation of embedded coding agents. Each task provides a plain-text engineering description, constrained workspace, and visible build-and-runtime surface. The agent must translate requirements into implementation and self-verification steps, then iterate until the required device behavior is achieved. The suite contains five embedded-control tasks and four feedback scenarios: one-shot generation, realistic self-verification, CI-style red/green feedback, and oracle-style detailed feedback.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一项用于嵌入式编码智能体闭环评估的基准测试。 每个任务都提供一个纯文本的工程描述、受约束的工作空间以及可见的构建和运行时界面。 智能体必须将需求转化为实现和自我验证步骤，然后不断迭代，直到达到所需的设备行为。 该测试套件包含五个嵌入式控制任务和四种反馈场景：一次性生成、逼真的自我验证、CI风格的红/绿反馈，以及神谕风格的详细反馈。

sents.zh: 我们提出了一项用于嵌入式编码智能体闭环评估的基准测试。

sents.zh: 智能体必须将需求转化为实现和自我验证步骤，然后不断迭代，直到达到所需的设备行为。

sents.en: The suite contains five embedded-control tasks and four feedback scenarios: one-shot generation, realistic self-verification, CI-style red/green feedback, and oracle-style detailed feedback.
sents.zh: 该测试套件包含五个嵌入式控制任务和四种反馈场景：一次性生成、逼真的自我验证、CI风格的红/绿反馈，以及神谕风格的详细反馈。

paragraphs.en: The implementation targets simulated ESP32 firmware for reproducibility. We evaluate seven GPT-family and Qwen-family configurations across five tasks and four scenarios, with three repetitions per condition for 420 runs. gpt-5.4 has the highest pass rate among evaluated configurations but does not saturate the benchmark; qwen3.5-27B is the strongest observed local model; and smaller local models degrade sharply in pass rate and search efficiency. These results suggest that capable local embedded coding agents are emerging.
paragraphs.zh: 为实现可重复性，该实现针对模拟的 ESP32 固件进行优化。 我们在五个任务和四个场景中对七种 GPT 系列和 Qwen 系列的配置进行了评估，每个条件重复三次，共执行了 420 次运行。在评估的配置中，gpt-5.4 的通过率最高，但尚未达到基准测试的极限；qwen3.5-27B 是观察到的本地模型中最强的；而较小的本地模型在通过率和搜索效率方面急剧下降。 这些结果表明，功能强大的本地嵌入式编码智能体正在逐渐出现。

paragraphs.en: Keywords: embedded software, large language models, language model agents, software engineering benchmarks
paragraphs.zh: 关键词：嵌入式软件、大型语言模型、语言模型智能体、软件工程基准测试

paragraphs.en: We introduce a closed-loop benchmark for embedded firmware coding agents, i.e., tool-using LLM systems that can autonomously execute bounded build-test-debug loops.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种嵌入式固件编码智能体的闭环基准测试，即能够自主执行有限构建-测试-调试循环的工具使用型大型语言模型系统。

paragraphs.en: The benchmark targets why agents matter for embedded work: tasks begin from plain-text engineering handoffs and require visible build, test, runtime, repair, and stopping decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 该基准测试旨在探究智能体在嵌入式工作中为何至关重要：任务始于纯文本的工程交接，并需要明确的构建、测试、运行时操作、修复和停止决策。

paragraphs.en: The evaluation spans five tasks, four feedback regimes, seven models, and three repetitions for a total of 420 runs.
paragraphs.zh: 评估涵盖五个任务、四种反馈机制、七种模型和三次重复，总计 420 次运行。

paragraphs.en: The model set combines two hosted frontier systems with five local Qwen variants.
paragraphs.zh: 该模型集结合了两个托管的前沿系统与五个本地 Qwen 变体。

paragraphs.en: gpt-5.4 has the highest observed pass rate among the evaluated configurations, while qwen3.5-27B is the strongest observed local model and points to viable on-premises embedded-agent workflows.
paragraphs.zh: 在评估的配置中，gpt-5.4 的观察到的通过率最高，而 qwen3.5-27B 是观察到的性能最强的本地模型，表明本地部署的嵌入式智能体工作流程具有可行性。

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs), trained on very large corpora of natural language and source code, now show strong capabilities across a wide variety of tasks [ 1 ] . In software settings, they can interpret requirements, summarize repository state, generate candidate implementations, explain failures, and propose repairs [ 2 ] . By themselves, however, they usually act as single-turn text generators. Agentic coding systems extend them with a persistent workspace and explicit tool use [ 3 ] , allowing the model to read and edit files, run builds and tests, inspect logs, and revise a partial solution over multiple steps rather than answering only once. In other words, a coding agent does not only suggest code; within a bounded tool environment, it can autonomously act on a repository, observe the consequences, and continue working until it decides to stop or submit.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）在极其庞大的自然语言和源代码语料库上进行训练，如今在各种任务中展现出强大的能力 [ 1 ] 。 在软件开发场景中，它们能够解读需求、总结仓库状态、生成候选实现方案、解释故障原因并提出修复建议 [ 2 ] 。 然而，仅凭自身能力，它们通常只能作为单轮文本生成器发挥作用。 智能体编码系统通过为其配备持久化的工作空间和明确的工具使用功能来扩展其能力 [ 3 ] ，使模型能够读取和编辑文件、运行构建与测试、检查日志，并在多个步骤中逐步完善部分解决方案，而不仅仅是单次作答。 换言之，编码智能体不仅能提出代码建议；在受限的工具环境中，它还能自主对仓库进行操作、观察结果，并持续工作，直到决定停止或提交成果。

paragraphs.en: This shift from one-shot generation to iterative, feedback-driven work is central to practical automation in software engineering. Recent benchmark work has shown that realistic measurement must account for whether models can process failure signals and improve a solution over repeated attempts [ 4 , 5 ] . Agent-oriented systems and evaluations further emphasize the importance of planning, tool use, execution, and iterative repair in realistic development environments [ 6 , 7 ] . The agent framing is therefore useful because many engineering tasks are bottlenecked not by producing an initial candidate, but by validating, debugging, and repairing that candidate until it satisfies the intended behavior. Embedded software is a particularly compelling target for this kind of evaluation: firmware correctness depends on behavior in closed loop with sensors, actuators, timing constraints, and safety interlocks, so success requires more than static source-level quality.
paragraphs.zh: 从一次性生成转向迭代、以反馈驱动的工作模式，是软件工程领域实用自动化的核心。 近期的基准测试研究表明，真实的评估必须考虑模型是否能够处理失败信号，并在多次尝试中改进解决方案 [4, 5]。 面向智能体的系统与评估方法进一步强调了在真实开发环境中规划、工具使用、执行和迭代修复的重要性 [6, 7]。 因此，采用智能体框架十分有用，因为许多工程任务的瓶颈并非在于生成初始候选方案，而在于验证、调试和修复该方案，直到其满足预期的行为要求。 嵌入式软件是这类评估极具吸引力的目标：固件的正确性取决于其与传感器、执行器、时间约束和安全联锁之间的闭环行为，因此成功实现不仅需要静态的源代码质量。

paragraphs.en: Embedded software development is therefore qualitatively different from standard code-generation tasks. A controller may look reasonable in a code review and still fail once it interacts with asynchronous sensor streams, hysteresis, timeout handling, or sequence control. For the same reason, repository-level issue-resolution benchmarks do not fully cover the embedded setting either: they capture iterative software work, but not the hardware-facing closed loop in which firmware correctness depends on dynamic behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，嵌入式软件开发在性质上不同于标准的代码生成任务。 一个控制器在代码审查中可能看似合理，但一旦与异步传感器流、滞后效应、超时处理或序列控制交互时，仍可能发生故障。 出于同样的原因，仓库级别的故障解决基准测试也无法完全覆盖嵌入式场景：它们能够反映迭代式软件开发，却无法体现硬件相关的闭环机制——在该机制中，固件的正确性取决于动态行为。

paragraphs.en: Despite recent interest in applying modern coding agents to embedded and hardware-adjacent domains, the dominant emphasis is still on static synthesis, component-level checks, or offline correctness [ 8 ] . What remains less explored is the full agentic loop that makes modern coding agents useful in practice: starting from a plain-text specification of what must be implemented, formulating tests, implementing firmware, running it, learning from feedback, and iterating until the system behavior matches the requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管近期出现了将现代编码智能体应用于嵌入式和硬件相关领域的兴趣，但主流重点仍然放在静态合成、组件级检查或离线正确性上 [ 8 ]。 尚未得到充分探索的是，使现代编码智能体在实践中真正有用的完整智能体循环：从对需要实现内容的纯文本规格开始，制定测试方案，实现固件，运行它，从反馈中学习，并不断迭代，直到系统行为符合要求。

sents.zh: 尽管近期出现了将现代编码智能体应用于嵌入式和硬件相关领域的兴趣，但主流重点仍然放在静态合成、组件级检查或离线正确性上 [ 8 ]。

paragraphs.en: This motivates the central question of this paper:
paragraphs.zh: 这引出了本文的核心问题：

paragraphs.en: Can an agent, starting from a plain-text specification of required device behavior, iteratively write tests and firmware, execute that firmware in a target environment, and converge to the required embedded behavior through a closed feedback loop?
paragraphs.zh: 一个智能体能否从对所需设备行为的纯文本规范出发，迭代地编写测试程序和固件，在目标环境中执行该固件，并通过闭环反馈机制最终收敛到所需的嵌入式行为？

paragraphs.en: We argue that this question deserves its own benchmark because the capability of interest is not one-shot firmware generation, but iterative embedded engineering. The benchmark we present is intended to evaluate whether an agent can start from a prose engineering brief, translate that brief into implementation and verification actions, and ultimately satisfy a behavioral contract in closed loop. The design is therefore prose-first, contract-aligned, and centered on the real development steps that embedded engineers actually perform: implementing controllers, writing or refining tests, running builds, probing runtime behavior, and iterating on failure signals.
paragraphs.zh: 我们认为，这个问题值得拥有一个独立的基准测试，因为我们所关注的能力并非一次性固件生成，而是迭代的嵌入式工程实践。 我们提出的基准测试旨在评估一个智能体是否能够从一段文字形式的工程简报出发，将其转化为实现与验证动作，并最终在闭环中满足行为契约。 因此，该设计以文字描述为优先、与契约保持一致，并聚焦于嵌入式工程师实际执行的开发步骤：实现控制器、编写或优化测试、运行构建、探测运行时行为，以及对失败信号进行迭代改进。

sents.zh: 我们认为，这个问题值得拥有一个独立的基准测试，因为我们所关注的能力并非一次性固件生成，而是迭代的嵌入式工程实践。

sents.en: The benchmark we present is intended to evaluate whether an agent can start from a prose engineering brief, translate that brief into implementation and verification actions, and ultimately satisfy a behavioral contract in closed loop.
sents.zh: 我们提出的基准测试旨在评估一个智能体是否能够从一段文字形式的工程简报出发，将其转化为实现与验证动作，并最终在闭环中满足行为契约。

sents.en: The design is therefore prose-first, contract-aligned, and centered on the real development steps that embedded engineers actually perform: implementing controllers, writing or refining tests, running builds, probing runtime behavior, and iterating on failure signals.
sents.zh: 因此，该设计以文字描述为优先、与契约保持一致，并聚焦于嵌入式工程师实际执行的开发步骤：实现控制器、编写或优化测试、运行构建、探测运行时行为，以及对失败信号进行迭代改进。

paragraphs.en: In the current reference instantiation, we realize this methodology with an ESP32 firmware target running in QEMU [ 9 ] and deterministic plant simulators that model the controlled process. We simulate both the microcontroller and the plants/tasks because a benchmark should first be safe, repeatable, and easy to run at scale. This makes the evaluation reproducible and suitable for systematic comparison, while still exercising the core embedded loop of sensing, control, actuation, and verification. In this reference stack, the physical sensor/actuator boundary is intentionally virtualized through a UART protocol between firmware and simulator, which abstracts board-specific electrical integration while preserving the closed-loop control logic that the benchmark is meant to test. The ESP32/QEMU stack is therefore a concrete vehicle for the benchmark, not the boundary of the methodology itself.
paragraphs.zh: 在当前的参考实现中，我们通过一个运行于 QEMU [ 9 ] 的 ESP32 固件目标以及模拟受控过程的确定性植物模拟器来实现这一方法。 我们同时模拟微控制器和植物/任务，因为基准测试首先应当安全、可重复且易于大规模运行。 这使得评估过程具有可重复性，并适合进行系统性比较，同时仍能对感知、控制、执行与验证的核心嵌入式循环进行有效测试。 在此参考架构中，物理传感器/执行器的边界被有意地通过固件与模拟器之间的 UART 协议虚拟化，该协议抽象了板卡特定的电气集成，同时保留了基准测试旨在检验的闭环控制逻辑。 因此，ESP32/QEMU 堆栈是基准测试的具体载体，而非该方法本身的边界。

sents.en: In the current reference instantiation, we realize this methodology with an ESP32 firmware target running in QEMU [ 9 ] and deterministic plant simulators that model the controlled process.

sents.en: We simulate both the microcontroller and the plants/tasks because a benchmark should first be safe, repeatable, and easy to run at scale.
sents.zh: 我们同时模拟微控制器和植物/任务，因为基准测试首先应当安全、可重复且易于大规模运行。

paragraphs.en: The paper makes the following contributions:

paragraphs.en: A benchmark formulation for closed-loop evaluation of LLM agents on embedded firmware tasks, starting from a prose specification and ending in behavior-level validation.

paragraphs.en: A benchmark design centered on contract-aligned task packets, visible self-verification affordances, a five-task difficulty ladder, and four evaluation scenarios with different degrees of feedback visibility.

paragraphs.en: Prior work on software-engineering evaluation has established that realistic measurement requires more than one-pass code generation. Benchmarks such as SWE-Bench and its follow-ups showed the importance of testing whether models can interact with repositories, process failure signals, and revise solutions over multiple iterations [ 4 , 5 ] . In parallel, agent-oriented systems and evaluations such as SWE-agent [ 6 ] , Agentless [ 7 ] , and related program-improvement frameworks have emphasized planning, tool use, execution, and iterative correction in realistic development environments [ 10 ] . Together, this line of work provides the general evaluation perspective we adopt: practical capability is not only the ability to synthesize code, but also the ability to use feedback productively in a development loop.
paragraphs.zh: 关于软件工程评估的早期研究已经表明，要实现逼真的测量，仅靠单次代码生成是远远不够的。 SWE-Bench 及其后续基准测试表明，检验模型是否能够与代码库交互、处理失败信号并在多次迭代中修订解决方案至关重要 [4, 5]。 与此同时，以智能体为导向的系统与评估方法（如 SWE-agent [6]、Agentless [7] 及相关程序改进框架）则强调了在真实开发环境中进行规划、使用工具、执行操作和迭代修正的重要性 [10]。 综合来看，这一系列研究为我们提供了所采用的总体评估视角：实际能力不仅包括合成代码的能力，还包括在开发循环中有效利用反馈的能力。

paragraphs.en: At the same time, synthesis-focused benchmarks such as HumanEval [ 11 ] , MBPP [ 12 ] , and RepoBench [ 13 ] remain important because they isolate core functional code-generation ability. These datasets provide strong signal on local correctness and pattern-level coding skill. However, they do not fully represent embedded firmware work, where correctness often depends on stateful execution, asynchronous inputs, target constraints, low-level verification concerns [ 14 ] , and behavior under disturbance. In embedded settings, code that appears plausible in isolation may still fail once it is compiled, executed on a target, and exercised under temporal and safety constraints.
paragraphs.zh: 与此同时，以合成为重点的基准测试（如 HumanEval [ 11 ]、MBPP [ 12 ] 和 RepoBench [ 13 ]）仍然很重要，因为它们能够单独评估核心的功能性代码生成能力。 这些数据集为局部正确性和模式层面的编码技能提供了强有力的评估依据。 然而，它们并未完全代表嵌入式固件开发工作，因为在嵌入式开发中，正确性通常取决于状态感知执行、异步输入、目标约束、底层验证问题 [ 14 ] 以及扰动下的行为表现。 在嵌入式环境中，单独来看看似合理的代码，在编译后于目标设备上执行并经受时间和安全约束的考验时，仍可能失败。

paragraphs.en: The literature on LLMs for embedded and hardware-adjacent programming has also grown rapidly. Recent benchmark work has explicitly targeted embedded-system development and microcontroller-oriented evaluation, helping establish firmware engineering as a serious target for modern models [ 8 ] . Complementary studies have benchmarked LLMs for embedded systems programming in microcontroller-driven IoT applications, further broadening the empirical base for the area [ 15 ] . Survey work has also reviewed transformer-based source-code generation more broadly, covering coding-model architectures, tuning strategies, datasets, and evaluation metrics [ 16 ] . Adjacent low-level work has examined code generation for hardware-description and synthesis-oriented settings, including Verilog-focused benchmarks that are relevant to the broader question of model capability in hardware-near engineering domains [ 17 , 18 ] . Related systems work has also studied edge-device ML benchmarking [ 19 ] and on-device LLM deployment from a fixed-point simulation and hardware co-design perspective [ 20 ] , while agentic reasoning architectures have been explored for logic-code simulation tasks [ 21 ] . This work is valuable in establishing embedded software and related low-level domains as relevant targets for modern models. However, much of the existing evidence still centers on static synthesis, component-level checks, offline correctness, or narrow domain-specific reasoning tasks. Comparatively less attention has been given to the full agentic workflow in which a model starts from a prose engineering brief, writes or refines self-verification, runs firmware in a target environment, interprets staged feedback, and iterates until behavior-level requirements are satisfied.
paragraphs.zh: 关于将大型语言模型（LLM）用于嵌入式及硬件邻近编程的研究文献也迅速增长。 近期的基准测试研究明确针对了嵌入式系统开发及面向微控制器的评估，有助于将固件工程确立为现代模型的重要应用方向 [ 8 ] 。 补充性研究则在微控制器驱动的物联网应用中，对用于嵌入式系统编程的 LLM 进行了基准测试，进一步拓展了该领域的实证基础 [ 15 ] 。 综述类研究也更广泛地回顾了基于 Transformer 的源代码生成技术，涵盖了编码模型架构、调优策略、数据集及评估指标 [ 16 ] 。 邻近的低层研究工作则探讨了面向硬件描述与综合的代码生成问题，包括聚焦 Verilog 的基准测试，这些问题与模型在硬件邻近工程领域的能力这一更广泛议题相关 [ 17 , 18 ] 。 相关的系统研究还探索了边缘设备机器学习基准测试 [ 19 ] 以及从定点模拟和硬件协同设计角度出发的设备端 LLM 部署 [ 20 ] ，同时智能体推理架构也被用于逻辑代码的模拟任务中 [ 21 ] 。 这项工作对于确立嵌入式软件及相关低层领域作为现代模型的重要应用目标具有价值。 然而，现有证据大多仍集中在静态综合、组件级检查、离线正确性或狭窄的领域特定推理任务上。 相比之下，对完整的智能体工作流程的关注相对较少——在这一流程中，模型从文本形式的工程简报出发，编写或优化自我验证代码，在目标环境中运行固件，解读分阶段反馈，并持续迭代直至满足行为层面的需求。

paragraphs.en: Finally, simulation and emulation have long served as foundational evaluation substrates in robotics [ 22 ] , systems research [ 9 ] , and firmware analysis, including interrupt modeling from firmware logic [ 23 ] , because they enable reproducibility, controlled experimentation, and cost-effective stress testing. For embedded-agent research, simulation offers the practical advantage of repeated closed-loop execution without the fragility, safety risk, and operational overhead of immediate physical deployment. At the same time, simulation is not a replacement for real-device validation. In this paper, we use it as a deliberate methodological staging ground that supports rigorous comparison of agent behavior today, while informing future transitions to hardware-in-the-loop and real-machine studies.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，模拟与仿真长期以来一直是机器人学 [22]、系统研究 [9] 以及固件分析（包括基于固件逻辑的中断建模 [23]）的基础性评估平台，因为它们能够实现可重复性、受控实验和成本效益高的压力测试。 对于嵌入式智能体研究而言，模拟具有一个实际优势：可以在不承受即时物理部署所带来的脆弱性、安全风险和操作负担的情况下，进行反复的闭环执行。 与此同时，模拟并不能替代真实设备的验证。 在本文中，我们将其作为一种有意识的研究方法论准备阶段，既支持对当前智能体行为的严格比较，也为未来向硬件在环及真实机器研究的过渡提供指导。

paragraphs.en: Taken together, prior work motivates a benchmark that embraces the agentic evaluation workflow now common in academia and industry for realistic assessment of LLM agents in embedded development.
paragraphs.zh: 综合来看，先前的研究推动了一项基准测试的提出，该测试采用了当前学术界和工业界普遍采用的智能体评估流程，以实现对嵌入式开发中大型语言模型智能体的真实评估。

paragraphs.en: This benchmark evaluates whether an LLM agent can carry out a realistic embedded development loop from a natural-language engineering handoff. For each task, the agent receives a plain-text specification of required behavior and is expected to translate that specification into implementation and verification actions. In practice, this includes writing firmware, creating or refining tests, invoking builds and checks, interpreting failures, and iterating until behavior meets the stated requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 该基准测试评估 LLM 智能体是否能够基于自然语言形式的工程交接，执行一个真实的嵌入式开发循环。 对于每个任务，智能体会收到对所需行为的纯文本说明，并需要将该说明转化为实现和验证操作。 实际上，这包括编写固件、创建或完善测试、调用构建和检查程序、分析失败原因，以及持续迭代，直到行为符合既定要求。

sents.en: For each task, the agent receives a plain-text specification of required behavior and is expected to translate that specification into implementation and verification actions.

sents.en: In practice, this includes writing firmware, creating or refining tests, invoking builds and checks, interpreting failures, and iterating until behavior meets the stated requirements.
sents.zh: 实际上，这包括编写固件、创建或完善测试、调用构建和检查程序、分析失败原因，以及持续迭代，直到行为符合既定要求。

paragraphs.en: The benchmark is designed around simulated tasks so that experiments remain safe, repeatable, and comparable across models. Simulation allows many controlled runs with consistent task conditions while still exercising the core engineering workflow that matters for embedded automation. Detailed interfaces, execution mechanics, and evaluator behavior are introduced in the following subsections.
paragraphs.zh: 该基准测试围绕模拟任务进行设计，以确保实验在跨模型比较时保持安全、可重复且具有可比性。 模拟技术允许在一致的任务条件下进行多次受控运行，同时仍能检验嵌入式自动化中至关重要的核心工程工作流程。 详细的接口、执行机制和评估器行为将在以下子部分中介绍。

paragraphs.en: The benchmark is designed to evaluate whether an agent can complete an embedded firmware task from a realistic but controlled engineering handoff: a prose description of required device behavior, a constrained implementation surface, visible tool affordances, and a target environment that can be executed repeatedly. The emphasis is on agentic capability, not only on final-source quality.
paragraphs.zh: 该基准测试旨在评估智能体是否能够完成一项嵌入式固件任务，这项任务源于一个真实但受控的工程交接流程：包括对设备所需行为的文字描述、受限的实现范围、可见的工具功能，以及一个可以重复执行的目标环境。 重点在于智能体的能力，而不仅仅是最终源代码的质量。

sents.en: The benchmark is designed to evaluate whether an agent can complete an embedded firmware task from a realistic but controlled engineering handoff: a prose description of required device behavior, a constrained implementation surface, visible tool affordances, and a target environment that can be executed repeatedly.
sents.zh: 该基准测试旨在评估智能体是否能够完成一项嵌入式固件任务，这项任务源于一个真实但受控的工程交接流程：包括对设备所需行为的文字描述、受限的实现范围、可见的工具功能，以及一个可以重复执行的目标环境。

sents.en: The emphasis is on agentic capability, not only on final-source quality.
sents.zh: 重点在于智能体的能力，而不仅仅是最终源代码的质量。

paragraphs.en: More concretely, the benchmark is intended to answer three questions:
paragraphs.zh: 更具体地说，该基准旨在回答三个问题：

paragraphs.en: Can the agent start from a simple plain-text specification and turn it into useful local verification, rather than depending on a benchmark-specific structured contract or hidden grader details?
paragraphs.zh: 智能体能否从简单的纯文本规范出发，将其转化为实用的本地验证，而不是依赖针对特定基准的结构化合同或隐藏评分器的细节？

paragraphs.en: Can the agent iteratively write or refine firmware and tests, build target code, run local checks, execute the controller against a target environment, and use the resulting feedback to improve the implementation?
paragraphs.zh: 该智能体能否迭代地编写或优化固件和测试用例，构建目标代码，运行本地检查，在目标环境中执行控制器，并利用由此产生的反馈来改进实现？

paragraphs.en: Can the agent use that loop to reach a final correct submission that satisfies both nominal control requirements and safety-critical requirements such as stale-input handling, interlocks, timeout behavior, and sequence recovery?
paragraphs.zh: 该智能体能否利用此循环，最终生成一个既能满足常规控制要求，又能满足安全关键性要求的正确提交结果？这些安全关键性要求包括旧输入处理、互锁机制、超时行为以及序列恢复等。

paragraphs.en: At a higher level, the benchmark is asking whether modern coding agents can do something that is both practically important and still underexplored in embedded software: begin from a prose engineering handoff, construct their own verification loop, and iterate all the way to behaviorally correct firmware rather than merely producing plausible source code. This is scientifically interesting because it moves the evaluation target from static synthesis to closed-loop engineering performance, and it is practically interesting because that is the level at which embedded automation would become genuinely useful in real development workflows.
paragraphs.zh: 从更高层面来看，这项基准测试旨在探究一个问题：现代编码智能体是否能够完成一项既具有实际重要性、又尚未在嵌入式软件领域得到充分探索的任务——即从一段文字形式的工程交接信息出发，构建自己的验证循环，并持续迭代，最终生成行为正确的固件，而不仅仅是产出看似合理的源代码。 这在科学上具有重要意义，因为它将评估目标从静态合成转向了闭环工程性能；同时，它在实践上也极具意义，因为这一层级正是嵌入式自动化在真实开发流程中能够真正发挥作用的关键阶段。

paragraphs.en: In the current implementation, these questions are instantiated on an ESP32 firmware target running in QEMU [ 9 ] and coupled to deterministic plant models. This concrete stack is important because it enables reproducible, controlled comparisons across models. However, the primary scientific contribution is the benchmark methodology itself: a prose-first, closed-loop evaluation framework that can be transferred to other embedded targets and simulation environments.
paragraphs.zh: 在当前实现中，这些问题被实例化到运行于 QEMU [ 9 ] 的 ESP32 固件目标上，并与确定性植物模型相耦合。 这种具体的技术栈之所以重要，是因为它使得跨模型的可重复、受控的比较成为可能。 然而，主要的科学贡献在于基准测试方法本身：一种以文本描述优先的闭环评估框架，该框架可以迁移到其他嵌入式目标及模拟环境中。

paragraphs.en: The primary workflow evaluated by this benchmark is the realistic_self_verify setting, in which the agent receives a prose engineering brief, operates inside a constrained workspace, and uses visible local tooling to verify its work before deciding whether to submit to the hidden evaluator. In this primary condition, the hidden evaluator is not part of the local repair loop: the agent iterates on the basis of visible evidence, not hidden failure messages. Figure 1 summarizes this workflow. The one-shot and richer-feedback settings described later in Section 3.5 are useful comparison conditions that will also be explored, but this self-verification-centered workflow is the main target of the benchmark.
paragraphs.zh: 本基准测试所评估的主要工作流程是 realistic_self_verify 设置，其中智能体接收一份文本形式的工程简报，在受限的工作空间内操作，并使用可见的本地工具验证其工作成果，然后再决定是否提交给隐藏的评估者。 在此主要条件下，隐藏评估者并不参与本地的修复循环：智能体基于可见的证据进行迭代，而非依赖隐藏的失败信息。 图 1 总结了这一工作流程。 在第 3.5 节后续描述的“单次示例”和“更丰富的反馈”设置是有益的对比条件，也将在测试中加以探索，但这一以自我验证为核心的工作流程才是本基准测试的主要目标。

paragraphs.en: Therefore, the workflow induces a simple contract. For each task:
paragraphs.zh: 因此，该工作流程产生了一项简单的协议。对于每个任务：

paragraphs.en: The agent receives a plain-text specification file describing the required behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 该智能体接收一个描述所需行为的纯文本规范文件。

paragraphs.en: The agent can edit only the intended implementation surface.
paragraphs.zh: 该智能体只能编辑预期的实现表面。

paragraphs.en: The agent can repeatedly use visible build, test, and runtime tooling to decide whether to keep iterating locally or to submit.
paragraphs.zh: 该智能体可以反复使用可见的构建、测试和运行时工具，以决定是继续本地迭代还是提交。

paragraphs.en: The hidden evaluator is consulted only upon submission; in the primary workflow it does not provide detailed failure feedback to drive the local loop.
paragraphs.zh: 只有在提交时才会咨询隐藏评估器；在主要工作流程中，它不会提供详细的失败反馈来驱动本地循环。

paragraphs.en: The task is solved only when a submitted implementation satisfies the full behavioral contract.
paragraphs.zh: 只有在提交的实现满足完整的行为合同时，任务才算完成。

paragraphs.en: This contract is deliberate. The goal is to measure whether an agent can start from a natural engineering handoff and iterate until the device behavior meets that handoff. The benchmark is therefore prose-first by default: the internal structured task definition remains hidden, and familiarity with benchmark-specific schemas is not supposed to be the main source of success.
paragraphs.zh: 这份合同是深思熟虑的。 其目标是衡量一个智能体能否从一次自然的工程交接开始，并不断迭代，直到设备的行为符合该交接要求。 因此，该基准默认以文本描述为主：内部结构化的任务定义保持隐藏，并且不应依赖对基准特定模式的熟悉程度作为成功的主要来源。

paragraphs.en: The workflow above describes what the agent experiences during evaluation. We next explain how the benchmark itself is built so that difficulty comes from the embedded control problem rather than from accidental benchmark artifacts. The following design principles guided both task design and the construction of the evaluator, simulators, and public task packets.
paragraphs.zh: 上述工作流程描述了智能体在评估过程中所经历的情况。 接下来，我们将解释基准本身是如何构建的，以确保难度源于其中嵌入的控制问题，而非偶然出现的基准人工产物。 以下设计原则指导了任务设计以及评估器、模拟器和公共任务包的构建。

sents.en: The workflow above describes what the agent experiences during evaluation.
sents.zh: 上述工作流程描述了智能体在评估过程中所经历的情况。

sents.en: We next explain how the benchmark itself is built so that difficulty comes from the embedded control problem rather than from accidental benchmark artifacts.
sents.zh: 接下来，我们将解释基准本身是如何构建的，以确保难度源于其中嵌入的控制问题，而非偶然出现的基准人工产物。

sents.en: The following design principles guided both task design and the construction of the evaluator, simulators, and public task packets.
sents.zh: 以下设计原则指导了任务设计以及评估器、模拟器和公共任务包的构建。

paragraphs.en: The benchmark follows five design principles.
paragraphs.zh: 该基准遵循五项设计原则。

paragraphs.en: Closed-loop first: The benchmark should evaluate iterative development, not just final code emission.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，闭环测试：基准测试应评估迭代开发过程，而不仅仅是最终代码的生成。

paragraphs.en: Contract alignment: Hidden checks must trace back to visible requirements in the prose handoff. If a hidden assertion matters, it should be stated in the public task packet; otherwise it should not be graded.
paragraphs.zh: 合同对齐：隐藏的检查项必须能够追溯至文本交接中明确说明的可见要求。 如果某项隐藏断言至关重要，则应在公开的任务包中明确说明；否则不应纳入评分范围。

sents.en: Contract alignment: Hidden checks must trace back to visible requirements in the prose handoff.
sents.zh: 合同对齐：隐藏的检查项必须能够追溯至文本交接中明确说明的可见要求。

sents.en: If a hidden assertion matters, it should be stated in the public task packet; otherwise it should not be graded.
sents.zh: 如果某项隐藏断言至关重要，则应在公开的任务包中明确说明；否则不应纳入评分范围。

paragraphs.en: Task-specific failures: If an agent fails, the failure should be attributable to the control problem, such as a wrong state transition, stale-sensor policy, or timeout rule, rather than to benchmark setup errors such as incorrect build instructions in the task handoff.
paragraphs.zh: 任务特定故障：如果智能体发生故障，该故障应归因于控制问题，例如错误的状态转换、基于过时传感器的策略或超时规则，而非基准测试设置错误，例如任务交接中不正确的构建说明。

paragraphs.en: Visible self-verification affordances: Realistic self-verification requires visible tooling, test locations, and runtime hooks; merely telling the agent to verify itself is not enough.
paragraphs.zh: 可见的自我验证支持：真实的自我验证需要可见的工具、测试位置和运行时挂钩；仅仅告诉智能体要自我验证是远远不够的。

paragraphs.en: Stack portability: The benchmark design should remain conceptually independent of the current microcontroller and simulator choices.
paragraphs.zh: 栈可移植性：基准测试的设计在概念上应独立于当前的微控制器和模拟器选择。

paragraphs.en: These principles are aimed at benchmark validity. A failure should be interpretable as a failure on the embedded-development problem, not on hidden benchmark trivia. Likewise, a success should reflect genuine convergence in a closed loop rather than accidental matching against an overexposed grading contract.
paragraphs.zh: 这些原则旨在验证基准的有效性。 失败应被解释为嵌入式开发问题上的失败，而非因隐藏的基准细节而导致的失败。 同样地，成功应反映封闭回路中的真正收敛，而非偶然匹配到过度暴露的评分机制。

sents.en: These principles are aimed at benchmark validity.
sents.zh: 这些原则旨在验证基准的有效性。

sents.en: A failure should be interpretable as a failure on the embedded-development problem, not on hidden benchmark trivia.
sents.zh: 失败应被解释为嵌入式开发问题上的失败，而非因隐藏的基准细节而导致的失败。

sents.en: Likewise, a success should reflect genuine convergence in a closed loop rather than accidental matching against an overexposed grading contract.
sents.zh: 同样地，成功应反映封闭回路中的真正收敛，而非偶然匹配到过度暴露的评分机制。

paragraphs.en: We operationalize these principles through a fixed construction pipeline for every task in the suite so that task difficulty comes from the embedded control problem, not from accidental benchmark artifacts. The process begins with task design: first, an engineering-level control plan is written so that it specifies intended behavior, safety constraints, off-nominal cases, and acceptance criteria. This plan is the source for both the public handoff and the hidden evaluator, which keeps the benchmark contract aligned across visible and private components.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过为套件中的每个任务采用固定的构建流程来将这些原则付诸实践，从而确保任务难度源于内置的控制问题，而非偶然的基准测试人工产物。 该流程始于任务设计：首先，需要编写一份工程级别的控制计划，以明确预期行为、安全约束、非正常情况以及验收标准。 这份计划既是公开交接的依据，也是隐藏评估器的来源，从而确保基准测试合同在可见组件和私有组件之间保持一致。

paragraphs.en: The next stage is simulation and execution-harness construction. For each task, we implement a deterministic process simulator and connect it to the firmware target so that the controller is evaluated in a true closed loop. As previously mentioned, in the current reference stack, the firmware runs on an ESP32 target in QEMU, and the process simulator exchanges sensor and actuator signals with that target through UART. We use simulation first because it is safer, repeatable, and practical for large comparative sweeps, while still preserving the core embedded workflow of sensing, control, actuation, and runtime feedback.
paragraphs.zh: 下一阶段是模拟和执行框架的构建。 对于每个任务，我们都会实现一个确定性过程模拟器，并将其连接到固件目标，从而在真正的闭环环境中对控制器进行评估。 如前所述，在当前参考栈中，固件在 QEMU 中的 ESP32 目标上运行，而过程模拟器通过 UART 与该目标交换传感器和执行器信号。 我们首先使用模拟方法，因为它更安全、可重复，并且适用于大规模对比扫描，同时仍然保留了感知、控制、执行和运行时反馈这一核心嵌入式工作流程。

sents.zh: 我们首先使用模拟方法，因为它更安全、可重复，并且适用于大规模对比扫描，同时仍然保留了感知、控制、执行和运行时反馈这一核心嵌入式工作流程。

paragraphs.en: After the simulator is stable, we write hidden ground-truth tests for grading. These tests are derived from the same requirements and cover nominal trajectories, boundary conditions, and safety-critical behaviors such as stale-input handling, timeout policies, and interlocks. The hidden suite defines final pass/fail status and remains private so that models cannot overfit to evaluator internals. Hidden-evaluator feedback is returned only in the two feedback-rich evaluation scenarios to assess whether this extra information helps the agents converge better and faster.
paragraphs.zh: 模拟器稳定后，我们为评分编写隐藏的真实值测试。 这些测试源自相同的需求，涵盖了正常轨迹、边界条件以及安全关键行为，例如处理陈旧输入、超时策略和联锁机制。 该隐藏测试套件定义了最终的通过/失败状态，并保持私有，以防止模型对评估器内部机制过度拟合。 隐藏评估器的反馈仅在两个富含反馈的评估场景中返回，以判断这种额外信息是否有助于智能体更优、更快地收敛。

paragraphs.en: The current task suite contains five tasks arranged as a deliberate difficulty ladder. Each task starts from a plain-text specification of desired behavior and requires the agent to converge to a correct controller through iterative validation. Difficulty is intended to come from the control problem itself: additional sensing channels, stronger coupling between decisions, explicit safe-state behavior, and eventually a full sequence-control problem. The defined tasks are presented below:

paragraphs.en: tank_fill_drain : A baseline single-sensor task with one level stream and one pump actuator. The task brief asks for simple threshold control, but not stateless threshold control: the controller must turn the pump on below 30, turn it off above 80, and preserve the previous safe output inside the 30–80 band rather than forcing a new command in the middle region. It must also distinguish normal short idle gaps from true timeout behavior and fail safe to pump-off on malformed input or stale data beyond 1000 ms. This task therefore establishes the basic pattern of prose specification, exact UART-visible actuation, timeout handling, and runtime self-verification.
paragraphs.zh: tank_fill_drain：一个基准单传感器任务，包含一个液位流和一个泵执行器。 任务说明要求简单的阈值控制，但并非无状态阈值控制：控制器必须在液位低于 30 时开启泵，高于 80 时关闭泵，并在 30–80 区间内保持先前的安全输出，而不是在该中间区域强制发出新指令。 它还必须能够区分正常的短暂空闲间隙与真正的超时行为，并在输入数据格式错误或数据陈旧超过 1000 毫秒时切换到泵关闭的安全模式。 因此，该任务确立了文本规范、精确的 UART 可见执行动作、超时处理以及运行时自我验证的基本模式。

paragraphs.en: thermal_chamber_hysteresis : A single-loop temperature-control task with a laggy plant and binary heater actuation. The controller must heat below 47, turn off above 52, preserve the previous safe state inside the nominal band, and perform anticipatory shutoff when temperature is rising in the 50–52 region. The prose brief explicitly treats that anticipatory heater-off as a valid holding behavior rather than a fault, so the agent must reason about trend, not only instantaneous thresholding. The task also includes malformed-input and stale-sensor fail-safe behavior plus a closed-loop hard ceiling at 56 °C, which means a controller can satisfy the visible threshold logic and still fail if it ignores plant lag.
paragraphs.zh: thermal_chamber_hysteresis：一个单循环温度控制任务，系统存在延迟，且加热器为二进制执行器。 控制器必须在温度低于 47 时加热，高于 52 时关闭，在正常范围内保持先前的安全状态，并在温度处于 50–52 区域上升时进行预判性关闭。 文本说明明确将这种预判性关闭加热器视为有效的维持行为，而非故障，因此智能体必须分析趋势，而不仅仅是依赖瞬时阈值判断。 该任务还包括对异常输入和传感器数据过时时的安全失效处理，以及一个 56 °C 的闭环硬性上限；这意味着即使控制器满足可见的阈值逻辑，若忽略系统延迟，仍可能失败。

paragraphs.en: pressure_vessel_interlock : A dual-sensor interlock task combining pressure regulation with door safety logic. Pressure freshness and door freshness are independent, and the controller must remain in the safe vent-open state until both signals have been observed validly. Once initialized, it must pressurize below 40 when sealed, relieve above 60, preserve the previous safe output inside the band, and immediately yield to door-open dominance. paragraphs.zh: pressure_vessel_interlock：一项双传感器互锁任务，将压力调节与门安全逻辑相结合。 压力新鲜度和门新鲜度相互独立，控制器必须保持在安全的通风开启状态，直到两个信号均被有效识别。 一旦初始化完成，密封状态下压力必须低于 40，超过 60 时必须释放压力，在压力带内保持先前的安全输出，并立即让位于开门优先逻辑。 该任务还要求控制器绝不能同时命令压缩机开启和通风开启，因此这是阶梯中首个需要显式执行执行器互斥和异步输入有效性验证的任务。

paragraphs.en: mixing_tank_fill_heat : A coupled level-and-temperature task with independent sensor freshness and a low-fill heater guard. The controller must open the inlet below 60, close it above 75, keep the heater off whenever level falls below 55, and only heat in the safe fill window when temperature is still below the working band. Near the upper temperature edge, it must again reason about temperature trend and switch the heater off early when temperature is rising. The task therefore combines multi-sensor validity, coupled decisions across two actuators, and a closed-loop hard ceiling at 51 °C.
paragraphs.zh: mixing_tank_fill_heat：一个液位与温度耦合的任务，传感器数据具有独立性，并设有低液位加热器保护。 控制器必须在液位低于 60 时打开入口阀，高于 75 时关闭；只要液位低于 55，就必须保持加热器关闭；且仅当温度仍处于工作带范围内时，才可在安全填充区间内加热。 接近温度上限时，系统必须再次分析温度趋势，并在温度上升时提前关闭加热器。 因此，该任务结合了多传感器有效性、两个执行器之间的耦合决策，以及 51°C 的闭环硬性上限。

paragraphs.en: filter_tank_sequence : A sequence-control task with two sensors, two actuators, and explicit stage transitions for filtering, settling, draining, and completion. The controller must count a clear streak using valid turbidity inputs only, enter settling after three clear samples while level remains high enough, wait at least 400 ms before opening the drain, and then recover correctly from disturbances that arrive during settling or draining by restarting filtering and resetting progress. It must also detect completion when the remaining level drops below the minimum threshold and return to the all-off state. This is the strongest task in the current ladder because correctness depends on state progression, timing, evidence accumulation, and disturbance recovery rather than on a single local threshold rule.
paragraphs.zh: filter_tank_sequence：一个序列控制任务，包含两个传感器、两个执行器，并明确定义了过滤、沉淀、排水和完成的阶段转换。 控制器必须仅使用有效的浊度输入来统计连续清澈样本的次数；在获得三个清澈样本且液位仍足够高时进入沉淀阶段；在开启排水口前等待至少 400 毫秒；然后在沉淀或排水过程中出现的扰动发生后，通过重新开始过滤并重置进度来正确恢复。 当剩余液位降至最低阈值以下时，控制器还必须检测任务完成，并返回全部关闭状态。 这是当前任务序列中最具挑战性的任务，因为其正确性取决于状态推进、时序控制、证据积累和扰动恢复，而非单一的局部阈值规则。

paragraphs.en: Taken together, these five tasks are intended to form a deliberate ladder of increasing embedded-control difficulty, as summarized in Table 1 . The progression starts with a simple single-sensor threshold controller, then adds plant lag and anticipatory control, asynchronous multi-sensor interlocks, coupled multi-actuator decisions, and finally timed sequence control with explicit disturbance recovery. This structure is useful because it helps separate models not only by raw coding ability, but also by their ability to maintain controller state, reason over asynchronous observations, and build stronger self-verification loops as the control problem becomes richer.
paragraphs.zh: 综合来看，这五项任务旨在构成一个有意识的、嵌入控制难度逐步提升的阶梯，具体如表 1 所示。 这一进阶过程始于一个简单的单传感器阈值控制器，随后加入系统延迟和预测性控制、异步多传感器联锁、耦合的多执行器决策，最后则是带有明确扰动恢复机制的时序控制。 这种结构之所以有用，是因为它不仅有助于根据原始编码能力区分模型，还有助于根据它们在维护控制器状态、对异步观测进行推理以及随着控制问题日益复杂而构建更强自验证循环方面的能力来区分模型。

sents.en: Taken together, these five tasks are intended to form a deliberate ladder of increasing embedded-control difficulty, as summarized in Table 1 .

sents.en: The progression starts with a simple single-sensor threshold controller, then adds plant lag and anticipatory control, asynchronous multi-sensor interlocks, coupled multi-actuator decisions, and finally timed sequence control with explicit disturbance recovery.

sents.en: This structure is useful because it helps separate models not only by raw coding ability, but also by their ability to maintain controller state, reason over asynchronous observations, and build stronger self-verification loops as the control problem becomes richer.

paragraphs.en: oneshot_blind : The agent is restricted to a single submission, no hidden feedback is returned, and the public self-verification helpers are intentionally omitted. paragraphs.en: These four scenarios should therefore not be read as a single monotone leaderboard. They are complementary lenses over the same tasks. realistic_self_verify measures the core target capability, oneshot_blind isolates first-pass implementation skill, and ci_red_green plus oracle_full show how strongly each model depends on progressively richer hidden guidance. Together, they make it possible to attribute gains to different mechanisms: specification understanding, self-verification quality, and dependence on external feedback.

paragraphs.en: The scenario axis also provides a targeted ablation of the two design principles that are behavioral rather than benchmark-validity constraints: closed-loop iteration and visible self-verification. In particular, the contrast between oneshot_blind and realistic_self_verify holds the task prose, hidden evaluator, tool harness, model set, and run budget fixed while changing whether the agent can use the visible build, test, and runtime surface for iterative self-verification before submission. By contrast, contract alignment, task-specific failure attribution, and stack portability are benchmark-hygiene constraints enforced by construction: violating them would introduce hidden unstated requirements, harness artifacts, or stack-specific assumptions rather than isolate useful agent behavior.

paragraphs.en: All code and data used to replicate the results of this paper are publicly available at https://github.com/jgcarrasco/closed_loop_evaluation_agents_embedded . The present implementation instantiates the benchmark on an ESP32 firmware target executed in QEMU and coupled to deterministic plant models implemented in Python. ESP-IDF provides the firmware build system and target support [ 24 ] , QEMU provides a reproducible execution substrate for the embedded target [ 9 ] , and the open-source pi coding-agent harness handles model interaction and tool mediation [ 25 ] . For the local open-weight experiments, Docker provides reproducible environment packaging [ 26 ] , and llama.cpp serves the local models under a common inference stack [ 27 ] . Each task has a task-specific runtime module under sim/tasks/ that defines the hidden scenarios, advances the plant state, emits sensor frames, consumes actuator commands from the firmware, and evaluates whether the resulting closed-loop behavior satisfied the scenario contract. This keeps the benchmark logic explicit and inspectable for humans while keeping the hidden evaluator itself out of the agent-visible workspace.

paragraphs.en: The common runtime harness launches the firmware in QEMU, exposes UART0 through a local TCP socket, and communicates with the firmware over newline-delimited ASCII frames. On the plant-to-firmware side, the runtime sends task-specific sensor frames such as SENSE LEVEL 25 , SENSE TEMP 47 , or SENSE DOOR OPEN , plus explicit fault frames such as FAULT SENSOR_TIMEOUT . On the firmware-to-plant side, the harness expects exact task-specific actuator lines such as ACT PUMP ON , ACT HEATER OFF , or ACT DRAIN OPEN . This UART boundary is a simulation surrogate for real embedded I/O, where the same controller logic would more typically read GPIO/ADC/bus-connected sensors and drive actuators through GPIO, PWM, relays, or peripheral interfaces. The benchmark intentionally abstracts that board-specific electrical integration layer so that the evaluation stays focused on closed-loop control behavior, staged verification, and repair rather than on one particular hardware wiring stack. This exact-string contract is therefore part of the benchmark: hidden checks do not grade internal helper names or refactors, but they do grade the externally visible control behavior and UART-visible actuation surface.
paragraphs.zh: 通用的运行时框架在 QEMU 中启动固件，通过本地 TCP 套接字暴露 UART0，并以换行符分隔的 ASCII 帧与固件通信。 在从设备到固件的方向上，运行时发送任务特定的传感器帧，例如 SENSE LEVEL 25、SENSE TEMP 47 或 SENSE DOOR OPEN，以及明确的故障帧，例如 FAULT SENSOR_TIMEOUT。 在从固件到设备的方向上，该框架期望精确的任务特定执行器指令，例如 ACT PUMP ON、ACT HEATER OFF 或 ACT DRAIN OPEN。 这个 UART 边界是真实嵌入式 I/O 的模拟替代方案；在实际系统中，相同的控制器逻辑通常会读取 GPIO/ADC/总线连接的传感器，并通过 GPIO、PWM、继电器或外围接口驱动执行器。 该基准测试有意抽象掉了与特定电路板相关的电气集成层，以便评估能专注于闭环控制行为、分阶段验证和修复，而非特定的硬件布线架构。 因此，这种精确字符串的契约是基准测试的一部分：隐藏的检查不会评估内部辅助函数名称或重构，但会评估外部可见的控制行为和 UART 可见的执行器接口。

sents.en: This UART boundary is a simulation surrogate for real embedded I/O, where the same controller logic would more typically read GPIO/ADC/bus-connected sensors and drive actuators through GPIO, PWM, relays, or peripheral interfaces.
sents.zh: 这个 UART 边界是真实嵌入式 I/O 的模拟替代方案；在实际系统中，相同的控制器逻辑通常会读取 GPIO/ADC/总线连接的传感器，并通过 GPIO、PWM、继电器或外围接口驱动执行器。

sents.en: The benchmark intentionally abstracts that board-specific electrical integration layer so that the evaluation stays focused on closed-loop control behavior, staged verification, and repair rather than on one particular hardware wiring stack.
sents.zh: 该基准测试有意抽象掉了与特定电路板相关的电气集成层，以便评估能专注于闭环控制行为、分阶段验证和修复，而非特定的硬件布线架构。

sents.en: This exact-string contract is therefore part of the benchmark: hidden checks do not grade internal helper names or refactors, but they do grade the externally visible control behavior and UART-visible actuation surface.
sents.zh: 因此，这种精确字符串的契约是基准测试的一部分：隐藏的检查不会评估内部辅助函数名称或重构，但会评估外部可见的控制行为和 UART 可见的执行器接口。

paragraphs.en: We use four outcome labels when summarizing hidden-evaluation results. PASS means that the submitted implementation satisfies all hidden host and closed-loop checks. HOST denotes a hidden host-test failure: the submission reaches the hidden evaluator, but fails host-side build or unit tests before the QEMU closed-loop plant scenarios are accepted. INT denotes an integration failure: the submission passes the preceding host-test stage but fails during the QEMU-based closed-loop evaluation, for example because the firmware emits the wrong UART-visible actuator command, mishandles timing or stale inputs, violates a safety constraint, or fails a task-specific plant scenario. NONE means that the run ended without a final submission.
paragraphs.zh: 在总结隐藏评估结果时，我们使用四个结果标签。 PASS 表示提交的实现通过了所有隐藏主机和闭环检查。 HOST 表示隐藏主机测试失败：提交内容到达了隐藏评估器，但在 QEMU 闭环场景被接受之前，主机端的构建或单元测试失败了。 INT 表示集成失败：提交内容通过了前面的主机测试阶段，但在基于 QEMU 的闭环评估中失败，例如因为固件发出了错误的 UART 可见执行器命令、错误处理了过时输入或时序问题、违反了安全约束，或者未能通过特定任务的场景测试。 NONE 表示运行在未生成最终提交的情况下结束。

paragraphs.en: The plant models are deterministic state machines rather than stochastic simulators. For the simplest tank_fill_drain task, for example, the plant state contains only the current level, the pump state, and simulated time in milliseconds. Each plant step advances time by a fixed tick and updates the level according to a simple fill-minus-drain rule. More complex tasks add lag, coupled sensors, multi-actuator dynamics, or explicit sequence state, but they follow the same principle: identical inputs should produce identical traces so that runs remain reproducible across models and across repeated evaluations. During each hidden scenario, the runtime records a full transcript of UART exchanges plus structured trace samples and summary metrics, which makes failures diagnosable without revealing the hidden checks to the agent.
paragraphs.zh: 这些植物模型是确定性的状态机，而非随机模拟器。 以最简单的 tank_fill_drain 任务为例，植物状态仅包含当前液位、泵的状态以及以毫秒为单位的模拟时间。 每个植物步骤都会按固定的时间步长推进时间，并根据简单的“填充减排水”规则更新液位。 更复杂的任务会增加延迟、耦合传感器、多执行器动态或显式序列状态，但它们遵循相同的原理：相同的输入应产生相同的轨迹，从而确保在不同模型和重复评估中运行结果可重现。 在每个隐藏场景期间，运行时系统会记录完整的 UART 通信转录文本，以及结构化的轨迹样本和摘要指标，这使得无需向智能体揭示隐藏的检查项即可诊断故障。

paragraphs.en: The easiest task, tank_fill_drain , is a good concrete example of the benchmark contract. The public task brief tells the agent that the controller must turn the pump on when LEVEL < 30 , turn it off when LEVEL > 80 , preserve the previous safe output in the mid-band, and fail safe to pump-off on malformed input or timeout. It also explicitly instructs the agent to create its own visible tests and at least one firmware-level runtime probe before submission. The hidden host checks then validate whether those public requirements were actually met. Representative hidden checks for this task include preserving the current safe ON state in the mid-band and forcing pump-off after the bounded timeout window.
paragraphs.zh: 最简单的任务 tank_fill_drain 是基准合同的典型实例。 公开的任务说明告知智能体：当 LEVEL < 30 时必须开启泵，当 LEVEL > 80 时必须关闭泵，在中频段保持先前的安全输出，并在输入格式错误或超时时执行安全故障处理，停止泵送。 该说明还明确指示智能体在提交前自行创建可见的测试用例以及至少一个固件级别的运行时探针。 隐藏的宿主检查随后会验证这些公开要求是否确实得到满足。 该任务的典型隐藏检查包括：在中频段保持当前的安全开启状态，以及在有限的超时窗口结束后强制停止泵送。

paragraphs.en: This example illustrates what the agent must actually do in the benchmark. It is not enough to emit plausible controller code. The agent must edit the constrained firmware surface, write or refine local tests, build the firmware, and ideally exercise it end to end through the UART-visible runtime path before deciding to submit. That distinction matters because an agent can easily produce false greens with incomplete local tests. For example, it may validate the obvious low-threshold and high-threshold behavior while missing the mid-band latch or the exact timeout reaction. Hidden tests and hidden closed-loop scenarios are therefore necessary to distinguish genuine behavioral correctness from a locally convincing but incomplete self-verification story.
paragraphs.zh: 这个例子说明了智能体在基准测试中实际上必须执行的操作。 仅仅生成看似合理的控制器代码是不够的。 智能体必须编辑受约束的固件界面，编写或完善局部测试，构建固件，并且理想情况下，在决定提交之前，通过 UART 可见的运行时路径对固件进行端到端测试。 这种区别很重要，因为智能体很容易通过不完整的局部测试生成虚假的“绿色”结果。 例如，它可能会验证明显的低阈值和高阈值行为，但却忽略了中间频带的锁存机制或精确的超时响应。 因此，必须引入隐藏测试和隐藏的闭环场景，以区分真正的行为正确性与局部看似可信但不完整的自我验证过程。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate whether current coding agents can turn prose task descriptions into behaviorally correct embedded firmware under repeated closed-loop interaction. The study spans seven models across five tasks and four feedback scenarios, repeated three times for a total of 420 runs. The model set includes two hosted frontier systems ( gpt-5.4 and gpt-5.4-mini ) and five local open-weight Qwen variants ( qwen3.5-27B , qwen3.5-35B-A3B , qwen3.5-9B , qwen3.5-4B , and qwen3.5-2B ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了当前编码智能体能否在反复的闭环交互中，将散文形式的任务描述转化为行为上正确的嵌入式固件。 这项研究涵盖了五个任务、四种反馈场景下的七种模型，每个组合重复三次，总计进行了 420 次运行。 该模型集合包括两种托管的前沿系统（gpt-5.4 和 gpt-5.4-mini）以及五种本地开源的 Qwen 变体（qwen3.5-27B、qwen3.5-35B-A3B、qwen3.5-9B、qwen3.5-4B 和 qwen3.5-2B）。

paragraphs.en: All model evaluations reported in this paper are executed through the same pi harness [ 25 ] . This is deliberate: keeping the agent wrapper, tool interface, prompt surface, and run logging fixed reduces the risk of attributing scaffold differences to model differences. We chose this model set to cover a useful spread of deployment settings, model scales, and architectural forms, so that the evaluation captures both cross-family capability differences and within-family local scaling behavior.

paragraphs.en: We report the results in three complementary analyses:
paragraphs.zh: 我们在三种相互补充的分析中报告了结果：

paragraphs.en: First, we treat realistic_self_verify as the primary condition because it most closely matches the autonomous closed-loop workflow the benchmark is intended to measure.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，我们将 realistic_self_verify 视为首要条件，因为它最接近该基准旨在测量的自主闭环工作流程。

paragraphs.en: Second, we use the full four-scenario matrix to study how feedback visibility changes model behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 其次，我们使用完整的四场景矩阵来研究反馈可见性如何改变模型的行为。

paragraphs.en: Third, we focus on the local Qwen variants and study the trade-offs between model size, performance, and computational cost.
paragraphs.zh: 第三，我们重点关注本地化的 Qwen 变体，并研究模型规模、性能与计算成本之间的权衡。

paragraphs.en: Regarding the local Qwen models, they were all executed on a single NVIDIA RTX 4090 using llama.cpp . The evaluated family includes qwen3.5-27B , qwen3.5-35B-A3B , qwen3.5-9B , qwen3.5-4B , and qwen3.5-2B . We intentionally kept this study within a common GGUF 4-bit deployment regime, rather than mixing quantized and higher-precision checkpoints, even though a smaller model such as 9B could fit at higher precision on the same hardware. All local Qwen runs were executed with thinking disabled. This keeps numeric precision, serving format, and explicit test-time reasoning mode from becoming additional moving variables in the local scaling study so that the within-family comparison remains methodologically controlled. The local GGUF checkpoints were obtained from Unsloth’s published Qwen3.5 releases and deployment guide [ 28 ] , which provide a consistent public source for the family-wide local models. We did not evaluate models larger than the 35B version because of hardware constraints. We also omitted the 0.8B model because the 2B model finished with zero passes across all of its runs, recorded a first submission in only eight of them in the final curated bundle, and otherwise spent most of its budget in nonproductive search. On that basis, a 0.8B run was unlikely to add useful discriminative evidence beyond extending the same failure regime.
paragraphs.zh: 关于本地 Qwen 模型，它们均使用 llama.cpp 在单块 NVIDIA RTX 4090 上运行。 评估的模型系列包括 qwen3.5-27B、qwen3.5-35B-A3B、qwen3.5-9B、qwen3.5-4B 和 qwen3.5-2B。 我们有意将本研究限制在通用的 GGUF 4-bit 部署方案内，而非混合量化模型与更高精度的检查点，尽管像 9B 这样较小的模型可以在相同硬件上以更高精度运行。 所有本地 Qwen 运行均在禁用思考模式的情况下执行。 这样做可防止数值精度、服务格式和显式的测试时推理模式成为本地扩展研究中额外的变量，从而确保系列内比较的方法论控制。 本地 GGUF 检查点来自 Unsloth 发布的 Qwen3.5 版本及部署指南 [28]，该指南为整个模型系列的本地模型提供了统一的公开来源。 由于硬件限制，我们没有评估大于 35B 版本的模型。 我们还省略了 0.8B 模型，因为该模型在所有运行中均未通过任何测试，在最终精选的模型包中仅有八次运行记录了首次提交，其余时间大部分预算都消耗在无成效的搜索上。 基于此，运行 0.8B 模型不太可能提供超出相同失败模式之外的有效区分性证据。

Because the plant and harness are deterministic, the three repetitions are intended to measure agent/model stochasticity under a fixed environment rather than randomized task variation. This repetition count is intended to expose major behavioral differences and recurring failure modes, not to resolve small differences between adjacent model configurations. paragraphs.en: Table 2 summarizes the inference and harness configuration used in the evaluation. For hosted GPT models, we used the GitHub Copilot subscription access path to reflect a realistic developer-facing workflow; in that setting, sampling parameters are provider-managed and temperature/top-p controls are not exposed to the harness. paragraphs.en: This makes two points immediately visible. First, the benchmark is not frontier-saturated: even the strongest model leaves one miss in the primary condition, so the current five-task suite still produces visible headroom at the top end. Second, local agents are not merely toy baselines: the 27B local Qwen model posts a slightly higher pooled pass count than the smaller hosted frontier model in the benchmark’s primary setting, although the overlapping Wilson intervals show that this gap should not be over-read as a stable separation. That competitiveness comes at a substantial search cost, however. Relative to gpt-5.4-mini , qwen3.5-27B uses roughly 6.7 × \times as many tokens and about 2 × \times as many tool calls per primary-condition run to obtain its additional pass. Token totals are the provider/server usage totals recorded by the pi harness, including reported prompt/input, completion/output, and cache tokens where available. Because tokenization and reasoning-token accounting are backend-dependent, we interpret token ratios as reported interaction volume rather than provider-independent compute; tool-call ratios are the cleaner cross-backend behavioral signal.
paragraphs.zh: 这一点立刻揭示了两个问题。 首先，该基准测试尚未达到前沿模型饱和状态：即便是最强的模型，在主要条件下仍存在一次失误，因此当前的五个任务组合在性能顶端仍有明显的提升空间。 其次，本地智能体并非简单的玩具级基线模型：在基准测试的主要设置中，27B 的本地 Qwen 模型获得的总通过次数略高于较小的云端前沿模型，尽管重叠的威尔逊置信区间表明，这一差距不应被过度解读为稳定的性能差异。 然而，这种竞争力是以显著更高的搜索成本为代价的。 与 gpt-5.4-mini 相比，qwen3.5-27B 在每次主要条件运行中使用的 token 数量约为其 6.7 倍，工具调用次数约为其 2 倍，才能获得额外的通过次数。 token 总数由 pi 测试框架记录，包括提供商/服务器端的总使用量，涵盖已报告的提示/输入、完成/输出以及可用时的缓存 token。 由于分词和推理 token 的统计依赖于后端系统，我们将 token 比例视为报告的实际交互量，而非跨提供商独立的计算能力指标；而工具调用比例则是更清晰的跨后端行为信号。

paragraphs.en: The left-hand panel in Figure 2 reports pass counts out of three repetitions for each model-task pair, so it makes the replicated task-by-task separation explicit rather than relying only on the aggregate totals in the previous Table 3 .

paragraphs.en: Its main result is that the benchmark’s observed ordering is carried by a small number of sharply discriminative tasks. filter_tank_sequence is the strongest separator: only gpt-5.4 passes it in the primary condition, and even then only in two of the three repetitions. At the other extreme, tank_fill_drain is the anchor task: the two hosted models plus qwen3.5-27B and qwen3.5-35B-A3B solve it in every repetition, and even the weaker local models still manage it at least twice. paragraphs.en: The local-only analysis is where wall-clock becomes meaningful. All local Qwen runs in this study use the same pi harness, the same task packets, the same QEMU-based benchmark environment, the same llama.cpp serving stack, and the same NVIDIA RTX 4090. We also deliberately kept the study within one GGUF 4-bit deployment regime, rather than mixing quantized checkpoints with higher-precision variants. paragraphs.en: Table 5 shows that the best local operating point is the 27B dense model. It is the most accurate local model at 38/60 (63.3%), and it is slightly more interaction-efficient than the 35B-A3B MoE model. The 35B-A3B MoE model is the main counterexample. It reaches 26/60 (43.3%), submits earlier on the same hardware, but is less accurate and slightly more token-hungry on average. In this benchmark, the 35B-A3B model therefore looks like a throughput advantage rather than a capability advantage. A plausible explanation is that, despite the 35B model being larger, it is a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model [ 29 ] in which only about 3B parameters are simultaneously active during inference.

sents.en: It is the most accurate local model at 38/60 (63.3%), and it is slightly more interaction-efficient than the 35B-A3B MoE model.
sents.zh: 它在 38/60（63.3%）的准确率上是最准确的本地模型，并且交互效率略高于 35B-A3B MoE 模型。

sents.en: The 35B-A3B MoE model is the main counterexample.
sents.zh: 35B-A3B MoE 模型是主要的反例。

sents.en: It reaches 26/60 (43.3%), submits earlier on the same hardware, but is less accurate and slightly more token-hungry on average.
sents.zh: 它的准确率为 26/60（43.3%），在相同硬件上提交更早，但准确性较低且平均而言更消耗令牌。

sents.en: In this benchmark, the 35B-A3B model therefore looks like a throughput advantage rather than a capability advantage.
sents.zh: 因此，在此基准测试中，35B-A3B 模型看起来更像是吞吐量上的优势，而非能力上的优势。

sents.en: A plausible explanation is that, despite the 35B model being larger, it is a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model [ 29 ] in which only about 3B parameters are simultaneously active during inference.
sents.zh: 一个合理的解释是，尽管 35B 模型更大，但它是一个专家混合（MoE）模型 [29]，在推理过程中只有约 3B 个参数会同时激活。

paragraphs.en: The 2B model sharpens the lower boundary of the family even more. Despite being the smallest checkpoint, it is not the cheapest operating point in closed-loop use: averaged over its 60 pooled runs it consumes 54.95M tokens, 716.3 tool calls, and 29.7 minutes per run while producing zero passes. Its reported 1.3-minute time to first submission should not be read as an efficiency signal, because only eight of its 60 runs recorded a first submission in the final curated bundle.
paragraphs.zh: 2B模型进一步收紧了该模型族的下限。 尽管这是最小的检查点，但在闭环使用中它并非成本最低的运行点：在其60次合并运行的平均值中，每次运行消耗5495万令牌、716.3次工具调用和29.7分钟，且未产生任何通过结果。 其报告的1.3分钟首次提交时间不应被解读为效率的信号，因为在其60次运行中，仅有8次在最终精选的打包结果中记录了首次提交。

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 makes the same ranking visible visually in a way that separates the two resource axes. The left panel shows that the faster first-submission models are not necessarily the better ones: the 35B-A3B model submits earlier than 27B, but converts less of its available runs into success, while 2B submits almost immediately in the few runs that submit at all yet never converts that into success. The right panel isolates the token story even more clearly. As model scale decreases below the practical operating range, token demand rises sharply rather than falling: 4B is already far to the right of 27B and 35B-A3B, and 2B remains an extreme outlier. In other words, the failure mode at the lower end of this family is uncontrolled search rather than simple throughput loss.

The 4B model is close to the lower useful boundary of the current benchmark: it reaches only 5/60 runs (8.3%), yet averages 11.55M tokens and 179.2 tool calls. Its shorter average time to first submission is not evidence of efficiency; it is largely evidence of premature submission followed by repeated failure-driven search. The 2B model lies beyond that boundary: across 60 runs, it reaches zero passes, never solves any task in any scenario, and is dominated by long no-submission loops rather than productive repair.
paragraphs.zh: 较小的密集模型性能仍然急剧下降。 9B 模型在 14/60（23.3%）时仍有意义，但它所需的搜索量已经远重于 27B 模型，每次运行平均需要调用 103.5 次工具。 4B 模型接近当前基准测试的较低有效边界：它仅达到 5/60 次运行（8.3%），但平均消耗 1155 万个词元和 179.2 次工具调用。 其首次提交所需的平均时间更短，但这并非效率的证明；这主要表明模型过早提交，随后因反复失败而进行无果的搜索。 2B 模型则超出了这一边界：在 60 次运行中，它一次成功也未达成，在任何场景下都从未解决过任何任务，且其表现主要被冗长的无提交循环所主导，而非有效的修复过程。

paragraphs.en: The task-wise pattern points in the same direction. filter_tank_sequence remains the clearest local separator in the suite: across the twelve local runs per model-task pair, it is solved only once by qwen3.5-27B and never by the smaller local models. tank_fill_drain , by contrast, remains the easiest local task and is solved at least once by every local model down to 4B. The most deployment-relevant comparison remains between the 27B dense model and the 35B-A3B MoE model. The 35B model matches or exceeds the 27B model only on tank_fill_drain ; it is weaker on thermal_chamber_hysteresis , pressure_vessel_interlock , mixing_tank_fill_heat , and filter_tank_sequence . This is a strong indication that sparse-parameter throughput does not automatically translate into stronger autonomous embedded-agent behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 各项任务的模式指向同一方向。filter_tank_sequence 仍然是该系列中最清晰的局部分隔符：在每个模型-任务组合的十二次局部运行中，只有 qwen3.5-27B 成功解决过一次，而较小的局部模型则从未解决过。相比之下，tank_fill_drain 仍然是最简单的局部任务，所有局部模型（包括 4B 模型）都至少成功解决过一次。 与部署最相关的比较仍然是 27B 密集模型与 35B-A3B MoE 模型之间的对比。 35B 模型仅在 tank_fill_drain 任务上达到或超过了 27B 模型；在 thermal_chamber_hysteresis、pressure_vessel_interlock、mixing_tank_fill_heat 和 filter_tank_sequence 任务上，其表现则较弱。 这强烈表明，稀疏参数的吞吐量并不会自动转化为更强大的自主嵌入式智能体行为。

paragraphs.en: The evaluation results support three main interpretive claims. First, the primary realistic_self_verify condition is the most informative lens for judging autonomous embedded-agent capability. Second, the feedback-visibility axis is diagnostically useful because it separates self-verification from externally guided repair. Third, the shared-hardware local study changes the deployment story by showing how model scale interacts with latency, token demand, and search behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 评估结果支持三种主要的解释性主张。 首先，primary realistic_self_verify 条件是最具信息量的视角，可用于判断自主嵌入式智能体的能力。 其次，反馈可见性轴在诊断上很有用，因为它将自我验证与外部引导的修复区分开来。 第三，共享硬件的局部研究改变了部署的叙述方式，它展示了模型规模如何与延迟、令牌需求和搜索行为相互作用。

paragraphs.en: The most important model-separation pattern in the paper is the ordering observed under realistic_self_verify . That condition is the closest match to the intended benchmark use case, because the agent must rely on the visible build, test, and runtime surface rather than on hidden diagnostics. Under that condition, gpt-5.4 leads at 14/15 (93.3%), qwen3.5-27B posts the highest pooled count among non-frontier models at 9/15 (60.0%), gpt-5.4-mini reaches 8/15 (53.3%), the 35B/9B/4B local variants reach 4/15 (26.7%), 2/15 (13.3%), and 2/15 (13.3%) respectively, and qwen3.5-2B remains 0/15 while usually failing to submit at all.
paragraphs.zh: 本文最重要的模型分离模式是在 realistic_self_verify 条件下观察到的排序。 该条件最接近预期的基准用例，因为智能体必须依赖可见的构建、测试和运行时表面，而非隐藏的诊断信息。 在该条件下，gpt-5.4 以 14/15（93.3%）领先，qwen3.5-27B 在非前沿模型中取得最高的合并次数，为 9/15（60.0%），gpt-5.4-mini 达到 8/15（53.3%），35B/9B/4B 本地变体分别达到 4/15（26.7%）、2/15（13.3%）和 2/15（13.3%），而 qwen3.5-2B 仍为 0/15，且通常根本无法提交。

paragraphs.en: This ordering matters as a descriptive result because it reveals a clear capability gradient under the benchmark’s primary condition. It distinguishes models that can genuinely construct and trust local evidence from models that mainly recover when external search signal is made richer. It also highlights a practically important point: local open-weight agents are already nontrivial contenders in the benchmark’s primary setting. The best local model is not at parity with the frontier model, but it is clearly beyond a toy baseline. That is exactly the kind of deployment-relevant gradient the benchmark was designed to expose.
paragraphs.zh: 这种排序作为描述性结果具有重要意义，因为它揭示了该基准测试主要条件下清晰的能力梯度。 它区分了那些能够真正构建并信任局部证据的模型，与那些仅在外部搜索信号更丰富时才能恢复表现的模型。 它还突出一个具有实际重要性的观点：在基准测试的主要设置中，本地开放权重智能体已经是不容忽视的竞争者。 表现最佳的本地模型尚未达到前沿模型的水平，但显然已经超越了简单的基线模型。 这正是该基准测试旨在揭示的、与部署相关的性能梯度。

paragraphs.en: The scenario axis is best interpreted as a diagnostic tool rather than as a single monotone leaderboard. gpt-5.4 shows strong but not perfect stability across feedback visibility and is strongest in every scenario. Below that level, models react very differently to additional hidden feedback. gpt-5.4-mini improves most under CI-style red/green feedback. qwen3.5-27B is strongest in oracle_full and stays competitive in realistic_self_verify , which suggests that its relative strength is not merely hidden-feedback dependence. By contrast, the 35B-A3B MoE model improves sharply as hidden feedback becomes richer, which indicates that it can often repair once the evaluator points it in the right direction, but struggles to build a strong self-verification loop on its own.
paragraphs.zh: 场景轴最好被理解为一个诊断工具，而非一个单一单调的排行榜。gpt-5.4 在不同反馈可见性条件下表现出强大但非完美的稳定性，并且在所有场景中均表现最强。 在该水平以下，模型对额外隐藏反馈的反应差异显著。gpt-5.4-mini 在 CI 风格的红/绿反馈下提升最大。qwen3.5-27B 在 oracle_full 中表现最强，并在 realistic_self_verify 中保持竞争力，这表明其相对优势并非单纯依赖于隐藏反馈。 相比之下，35B-A3B MoE 模型随着隐藏反馈的丰富而显著提升，这表明一旦评估者为其指明正确方向，它通常能够自我修复，但难以独立构建强大的自我验证循环。

paragraphs.en: The local-only analysis adds a second practical lesson. paragraphs.en: The smaller dense models are also informative. The 9B model is a meaningful, if clearly weaker, embedded agent. paragraphs.en: The benchmark still has important scope limits that matter for interpretation. It studies deterministic simulated plants on a single ESP32/QEMU reference stack with UART-virtualized I/O, which is a deliberate choice for reproducibility and comparability rather than an attempt to cover the full complexity of embedded deployment. Likewise, the current suite is intentionally small and control-centric: the five tasks are enough to separate models on thresholding, hysteresis, sequencing, and interlocks, but they do not yet span the broader range of embedded workloads such as communication stacks, storage, power management, interrupt-heavy firmware, or longer-horizon mission logic. The evaluation also fixes one agent/tool surface and one common local deployment regime, so the reported rankings should be read as benchmarked results in this setting rather than as architecture-independent limits of all coding agents. However, these scope choices are also what make the study useful: they turn a noisy and difficult problem into a reproducible one, and they already produce clear capability gradients, informative failure modes, and actionable deployment trade-offs. On that basis, we view the present paper not as a final word on embedded-agent capability, but as a strong benchmark foundation on which broader and more realistic evaluations can now be built.
paragraphs.zh: 该基准测试仍然存在重要的范围限制，这些限制对结果的解释至关重要。 该研究在单个 ESP32/QEMU 参考堆栈上对确定性模拟植物进行了测试，其 I/O 通过 UART 虚拟化实现；这是为了可重复性和可比性而做出的有意选择，而非试图涵盖嵌入式部署的全部复杂性。 同样，当前的任务集也刻意保持精简并以控制为核心：五个任务足以区分模型在阈值设定、滞后效应、序列执行和互锁方面的表现，但尚未覆盖更广泛的嵌入式工作负载，例如通信栈、存储、电源管理、中断密集型固件或更长周期的任务逻辑。 该评估还固定了单一智能体/工具接口和一种通用的本地部署模式，因此所报告的排名应被理解为在此特定设置下的基准测试结果，而非所有编码智能体的架构无关性极限。 然而，正是这些范围上的选择使得研究具有实用价值：它们将一个复杂且难以处理的问题转化为可重复测试的问题，并已清晰地展现出能力梯度、具有信息价值的故障模式以及可行的部署权衡。 基于此，我们认为本文并非关于嵌入式智能体能力的最终结论，而是构建更广泛、更现实评估的坚实基准基础。

paragraphs.en: This paper presents a closed-loop benchmark methodology for evaluating coding agents on embedded firmware tasks, where success is defined at the level of observed device behavior rather than source-code plausibility alone. Starting from prose engineering handoffs, the benchmark asks whether an agent can iteratively implement, verify, diagnose, and repair firmware under a realistic tool-mediated workflow. In that sense, the main contribution is not only a five-task suite, but an evaluation framing: prose-first, behavior-level, and explicitly centered on self-verification in a target execution environment.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了一种闭环基准测试方法，用于评估编码智能体在嵌入式固件任务中的表现，其中成功与否的判断依据是观察到的设备行为，而不仅仅是源代码的合理性。 从文本工程化的任务交接开始，该基准测试旨在检验智能体是否能够在现实的工具辅助工作流程中，迭代地实现、验证、诊断和修复固件。 从这个意义上说，主要贡献不仅包括一个包含五个任务的测试套件，更是一种评估框架：以文本为起点、以行为层面为核心，并明确聚焦于目标执行环境中的自我验证。

paragraphs.en: The empirical study shows that this benchmark is already meaningful along several dimensions. It is executable at scale, reproducible under a deterministic simulation stack, and sufficiently discriminative to separate models both by final pass rate and by how they use feedback during iterative search. Across 420 runs, the primary realistic_self_verify condition emerges as the most informative lens on autonomous embedded-agent capability, because it requires the agent to construct and trust its own local evidence rather than relying on hidden evaluator guidance. Under that condition, gpt-5.4 has the highest observed pass rate at 14/15 (93.3%), while qwen3.5-27B is the strongest observed local model at 9/15 (60.0%). This result is notable in practical terms: the 27B local model remains genuinely competitive in the benchmark’s primary setting despite operating in a far smaller and more resource-constrained deployment regime than the hosted frontier system.
paragraphs.zh: 实证研究表明，该基准在多个维度上已经具有实际意义。 它支持大规模执行，在确定性模拟栈下可重复运行，并且具备足够的区分能力，既能根据最终通过率区分模型，也能根据它们在迭代搜索中利用反馈的方式加以区分。 在 420 次运行中，primary_realistic_self_verify 条件被证明是评估自主嵌入式智能体能力的最具信息量的视角，因为它要求智能体构建并信任自身的局部证据，而不是依赖隐藏评估器的引导。 在该条件下，gpt-5.4 的观测通过率最高，为 14/15（93.3%），而 qwen3.5-27B 是观测到的最强本地模型，通过率为 9/15（60.0%）。 这一结果在实际应用中值得关注：尽管 27B 本地模型运行在比托管前沿系统小得多且资源受限得多的部署环境中，它在该基准的主要设置中仍然具有真正的竞争力。

sents.zh: 这一结果在实际应用中值得关注：尽管 27B 本地模型运行在比托管前沿系统小得多且资源受限得多的部署环境中，它在该基准的主要设置中仍然具有真正的竞争力。

paragraphs.en: A second conclusion is that feedback visibility is not just a convenience variable but a diagnostic one. The four-scenario design shows that models differ not only in direct implementation ability, but also in how well they construct self-verification loops and how strongly they depend on richer hidden feedback to repair failures. Some models remain comparatively stable across scenarios, whereas others improve sharply only when the evaluator exposes richer search signal. This makes the feedback axis scientifically useful in its own right: it helps separate first-pass synthesis, self-verification quality, and externally guided repair instead of collapsing them into a single aggregate score.
paragraphs.zh: 第二个结论是，反馈可见性不仅是一个便利性变量，更是一个诊断性变量。 四种场景的设计表明，模型之间的差异不仅体现在直接执行能力上，还体现在它们构建自我验证循环的能力强弱，以及对更丰富的隐藏反馈的依赖程度。 某些模型在不同场景中保持相对稳定的表现，而另一些模型则仅在评估者提供更丰富的搜索信号时才会显著提升。 这使得反馈维度本身具有科学价值：它有助于区分初始合成、自我验证质量以及外部引导的修复过程，而不是将它们合并为一个单一的总分。

paragraphs.en: A third conclusion is practical. Under a common local deployment regime on shared hardware, the best local operating point in this study is the 27B dense Qwen model. The comparison with the qwen3.5-35B-A3B MoE model is especially informative: the MoE model reaches first submission faster, but the dense 27B model is clearly stronger on the benchmark overall. In this setting, the contrast is best interpreted as a trade-off between throughput and effective capability. Faster submission does not automatically translate into stronger autonomous embedded-agent performance, and sparse activation does not substitute for the ability to sustain reliable closed-loop search.
paragraphs.zh: 第三个结论具有实际意义。 在共享硬件上的通用本地部署方案中，本研究中的最佳本地运行点是 27B 密集 Qwen 模型。 与 qwen3.5-35B-A3B MoE 模型的对比尤其具有启发性：MoE 模型能更快地完成首次提交，但在整体基准测试中，密集的 27B 模型明显更强大。 在此设置下，这种差异最好被解释为吞吐量与有效能力之间的权衡。 更快的提交速度并不自动意味着更强的自主嵌入式智能体性能，而稀疏激活也无法替代维持可靠闭环搜索的能力。

paragraphs.en: The lower end of the local family reinforces the same lesson. Smaller local models degrade not only in pass rate but also in search efficiency, with the 2B checkpoint showing that lower nominal model size does not necessarily produce a cheaper or more usable agent when closed-loop interaction is taken seriously. In this benchmark, the key deployment boundary is therefore not simply whether a model can emit plausible code, but whether it can reliably converge through repeated verification and revision without falling into unproductive search.
paragraphs.zh: 本地模型的低端版本也印证了同样的道理。 较小的本地模型不仅在通过率方面表现下降，搜索效率也会降低；其中 2B 检查点表明，较低的标称模型规模并不一定意味着在闭环交互得到认真对待时，就能产生更便宜或更实用的智能体。 因此，在这一基准测试中，关键部署界限并非简单地取决于模型能否生成看似合理的代码，而是能否通过反复验证和修订可靠地收敛，而不会陷入无益的搜索循环。

paragraphs.en: Taken together, these results suggest that closed-loop embedded-agent evaluation should be treated as a distinct benchmarking problem rather than as a small variation on static code generation. The main scientific gap below frontier performance is not only implementation quality, but robust autonomous self-verification: the ability to generate local evidence, interpret it correctly, and stop only when the controller is actually ready. That is precisely the capability this benchmark is designed to expose.
paragraphs.zh: 综合来看，这些结果表明，闭环嵌入式智能体评估应被视为一个独立的基准测试问题，而非静态代码生成的一种微小变体。 当前性能前沿以下的主要科学差距不仅在于实现质量，更在于稳健的自主自我验证能力：即生成局部证据、正确解读这些证据，并且仅在控制器真正准备就绪时停止的能力。 而这正是该基准测试旨在揭示的关键能力。

paragraphs.en: Regarding future work, the most important next step is to carry the same methodology from deterministic simulation into hardware-in-the-loop and then carefully controlled real-device studies. This is the main long-term target of the benchmark, even though it is substantially harder experimentally, because only real hardware can fully surface effects such as sensor jitter, communication latency, watchdog behavior, startup transients, peripheral interaction, and deployment packaging. The role of the present simulation-based study is therefore methodological staging: it establishes a reproducible baseline from which hardware-facing evaluation can proceed in a controlled way.
paragraphs.zh: 关于未来的工作，最重要的下一步是将相同的方法论从确定性模拟扩展到硬件在环测试，然后再进行严格控制的真实设备研究。 这是该基准测试的主要长期目标，尽管在实验上难度要大得多，因为只有真实的硬件才能完全暴露出诸如传感器抖动、通信延迟、看门狗行为、启动瞬态、外围设备交互和部署打包等效应。 因此，当前这项基于模拟的研究所扮演的角色是方法论的铺垫：它建立了一个可重复的基准，从而能够以受控的方式开展面向硬件的评估。

paragraphs.en: At the same time, research on local models is especially promising for embedded-agent workflows because it offers direct control over both data and compute, which is highly relevant for privacy-sensitive, on-premises, and industrial settings. Future work should therefore continue to study local-model operating points, precision regimes, and agent/tool surfaces, alongside broader task extensions that include noisier and partially missing sensors, delayed or drifting signals, actuator saturation, restart-and-recovery behavior, multi-rate control loops, and richer fault-management scenarios. Together, these directions would turn the present benchmark from a single reproducible suite into a broader evaluation program for trustworthy embedded coding agents.
paragraphs.zh: 与此同时，本地模型的研究在嵌入式智能体工作流中尤其具有前景，因为它能够直接控制数据和计算资源，这与注重隐私、部署在本地以及工业场景的需求高度相关。 因此，未来的研究应继续探索本地模型的操作点、精度范围以及智能体/工具接口，同时拓展更广泛的任务场景，包括噪声更多或存在部分缺失的传感器、延迟或漂移的信号、执行器饱和、重启与恢复行为、多速率控制环路，以及更复杂的故障管理情境。 综合来看，这些方向将使当前的基准测试从一个单一的可复现套件，转变为一个用于评估可信嵌入式编码智能体的更广泛评估计划。
